\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-12},
  title = {Retraining and promotion are started by a person, and a failing gate blocks the merge},
  note = {\textbf{Revised on 2026-10-20}: a required CI check now enforces the verdict, which skips criteria an EDN entry waived; before, only the reviewer read it.},
  date = {2026-09-22},
  milestone = {M6: Monitoring},
  topic = {ML System Design, Model Performance},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {When the drift job flags the \texttt{ES} replay, a team member retrains with \texttt{ES} included and opens the promotion pull request by hand.
The merge is the promotion, and redeploying the previous image tag is the rollback (EDN-08).
A required CI check fails a pull request that changes \texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}lock} unless the committed \texttt{metrics.\allowbreak{}json} has \texttt{gate\_\allowbreak{}passed: true} and names the promoted model as \texttt{deployable\_\allowbreak{}variant}.
A criterion waived by an EDN entry listed in \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml} (SC-04, EDN-62) does not count, and \texttt{metrics.\allowbreak{}json} reports it.
FR-15 states this; the reviewer's approval stays on top.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item A watcher that runs \texttt{dvc repro} and opens the pull request on confirmed drift: new infrastructure to debug just before the final presentation.
\item The gate as a manual check only: one mistaken merge deploys a rejected model.
\item A check in CD: it fails only after the merge.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The \texttt{ES} holdout exists to show this loop closing (EDN-03).
A person reacting to the signal closes it too, and is safer live.
From M5 every merge to \texttt{main} deploys (NFR-13), and only the CI check stops a rejected model before the merge.
It needs no data and reads \texttt{gate\_\allowbreak{}passed}, so a new criterion changes nothing in it.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI noticed that the retrain-after-drift plan had never become a testable requirement and recommended the manual trigger because of the timeline.
On 2026-10-20 it found that no check read the verdict, laid out the options and recommended the CI check.
Lukas decided.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-22 (review of PR \#19) and 2026-10-20 (issue \#129).},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/requirements.md}{Requirements} FR-15, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/specification.md}{specification} FR-14 and FR-15, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/129}{issue \#129}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/19}{PR \#19}.},
